mentions.claim_text: He says that after a television interview he received an open-eyed vision in prayer that lasted longer than any he had had, with each scene drawn out, and begins to recount it.
mentions.quote: this Vision lasted longer than any Vision that I've ever had
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: framing for the vision that follows.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was warned in prayer about another financial crash coming and the collapse of the dollar, and was then caught up and shown New York City.
mentions.quote: another financial crash coming and the collapse of the dollar
mentions.falsify_match: A financial crash accompanied by a collapse of the dollar.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs. Undated. The dollar index has moved in an ordinary range since June 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a massive moon showing only a sliver, low over the horizon, seen first over New York and then in the same scene over Miami from a different angle.
mentions.quote: I see the same Moon Over uh Miami
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a crescent moon low on the horizon over the eastern seaboard occurs monthly and is not tied to a date or event here.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a massive earthquake destroy the area completely, the land broken off and elevated with water coming inland, and all of Anchorage, Alaska on fire the way Hawaii burned.
mentions.quote: all of Anchorage Alaska was on fire
mentions.falsify_match: A major earthquake with land uplift and inundation at Anchorage, followed by widespread fire.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such event. Undated, but the city is named and the effects are specific, which makes it checkable if it happens.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a spinning devil of war released on the earth and entering Putin, then a provocation from Poland over Ukraine, with Russia striking Poland using something never seen before.
mentions.quote: Russia would strike Poland and it would be something we've never seen before
mentions.falsify_match: A Russian strike on Poland with a novel weapon.
mentions.falsify_miss: No strike on Poland. Undated, and repeated across the corpus from March 2024 onward without one.

mentions.claim_text: He says the event brings a surge of patriotism among ordinary Americans who love the country and rise up.
mentions.quote: it brought a patriotism upon America
mentions.falsify_match: A visible surge of American patriotism following an attack.
mentions.falsify_miss: None follows. A rally-round-the-flag effect after an attack is the ordinary pattern, so this carries little risk.

mentions.claim_text: He says America will be hit by another nation and war will come to American soil, that he saw it on the West Coast and in the central part of the country, and that he saw ants hidden within cells, with the attack causing people to volunteer to serve out of patriotism.
mentions.quote: We will be hit by another nation. War will happen on America's soil
mentions.falsify_match: A foreign state attack on the continental United States, on the West Coast and in the interior.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attack. Undated, but the perpetrator category and the two regions are named.

mentions.claim_text: He says the BRICS nations are forming a financial coalition to route around US sanctions with Saudi Arabia because the petrodollar deal was broken, and that he had warned this was coming and had seen the Saudi crown prince put his foot down.
mentions.quote: they broke the petro dollar deal. I told you all it was coming
mentions.falsify_match: A functioning BRICS mechanism that lets members bypass US sanctions.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such mechanism. Note the claim that Saudi Arabia let a petrodollar agreement lapse in June 2024 was a widely circulated story with no underlying treaty; no such agreement expired.

mentions.claim_text: He says a major war is about to take place, not one nation against another but like the Second World War and much nastier, and that it will escalate continuously until the coming of the Lord and the rapture.
mentions.quote: a major war is about to take place
mentions.falsify_match: A general war of world war scale.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Tying the end point to the return removes any deadline, so continuous escalation always reads as confirmation.

mentions.claim_text: He says there will be an exposing of sexual perversions in homes, that the Lord is going to clean house and clean up his church, and that a great shaking is coming over America.
mentions.quote: there will be an exposing of this. And the Lord is going to clean house
mentions.falsify_match: A wave of exposures of sexual misconduct in church leadership.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Undated and unnumbered, and such exposures occur continuously.

mentions.claim_text: He says the remnant are the pillars who bring in the harvest, and refers back to the 350 million plague and a biological thing he has seen.
mentions.quote: I've told you about the 350 million uh the plague
mentions.falsify_match: A plague killing about 350 million people.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such plague. The number is the one hard figure in the thread and it is unmet.

mentions.claim_text: Asked about Hawaii, he says he saw a surprise attack similar to Pearl Harbor happening again, with fires, jets and a major attack on the military bases there, and people running to get away.
mentions.quote: I saw a surprise attack similar to Pearl Harbor happening again
mentions.falsify_match: A surprise attack on US military installations in Hawaii.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attack. Undated, but the location and the target type are specific.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord telling him it is time to get serious, that he is not pushing or pursuing enough for what is coming, and that a shifting is taking place, beginning while he prayed over Israel.
mentions.quote: he said it's time to get serious
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: personal exhortation with no event attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was led to pray over the tunnels in Israel ahead of the ground invasion, and that he saw plots against the soldiers, with the Lord repeating the words booby traps.
mentions.quote: the Lord kept speaking to me booby traps
mentions.falsify_match: Booby-trapped tunnels used against Israeli soldiers in the Gaza ground operation.
mentions.falsify_miss: None used. Note that tunnel booby traps had already been widely reported by June 2024, so this describes an established feature of the campaign.

mentions.claim_text: He calls for intercession and for angels to be sent to help, describes the enemy as ruthless and without conscience, and mentions being shown something about the tie between Israel and the United States.
mentions.quote: we'd send angels angels to go and help
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: intercession, with the Israel and America material explicitly withheld.

mentions.claim_text: He describes seeing light shining on America rather than darkness, with the darkness confined to the border area.
mentions.quote: there was light shining on America it was not Darkness
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: light and darkness over a country in vision have no observable measure.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told that they will never announce when it is going to happen, that it comes as a surprise attack the way it came against Israel, and that the thing to pray is that all hidden things be revealed so the enemy cannot blindside them.
mentions.quote: they're never going to announce to you when that's going to happen
mentions.falsify_match: A surprise attack on America with no warning.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Note the structure: an event defined as unannounceable cannot be dated, so no window can ever expire.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was told things would accelerate again at Passover and escalate over the red heifer, and that it is happening now on the news.
mentions.quote: it would do it again during Passover and that things would accelerate
mentions.falsify_match: Escalation around Passover connected to the red heifer.
mentions.falsify_miss: A quiet Passover. Note the red heifers were brought to Israel in September 2022 and were already a standing news topic.
